_note: Fixed on 12 Nov 2026 BEFORE any Phase 4 result. Not tuned in Phase 4; any later change is chosen on the 6 dev folds only and logged in roadmap section 10.
_rounds: Fixed number of boosting rounds, no early stopping: early stopping on the held-out match would let the validation fold choose the model.

ha_model._min_data_in_leaf: larger than D: 5 seeds of the same match share players, so rows are less independent

trivial_d_rule._why: Roadmap 4.1 comparison: 'both teams slow'. Uses the slow-speed band already in features.json (physics, not fitted).

trivial_ha_rule._why: Roadmap 4.2 comparison: last reliably measured nearest-player margin, + means home.

segmenter._note: Grid fixed on 12 Nov 2026 BEFORE any Phase 5 result (roadmap 5.2). Costs are in log-odds units per switch. Chosen by mean spellF1 over the 6 dev folds (30 units).
segmenter._edge_rule: If the best pair is on the edge of the grid, extend that axis by ONE doubling step once, and log it. No other search.
segmenter._grid_extension: 12 Nov: best pair (64, 8) was on the cost_d edge, so cost_d was extended once by one doubling (128), per _edge_rule.
segmenter._chosen: Best mean spellF1 over the 30 dev units in the fixed grid: 0.5525 (roadmap 5.2, runs/phase5/grid.csv).

change_model._note: Phase 6 round 1, fixed 12 Nov BEFORE any result. Target: a true H<->A change (inside a half, both frames live) within +-target_window_frames. Same features and LightGBM settings as ha_model, same 6 folds.

change_cost._note: Switching cost per frame = cost_h + weight * (-logit(p_c) - ref), floor min_cost; ref = median of -logit(p_c) on the fold's training rows. weight 0 = the current constant cost (control). cost_d stays 64.
change_cost._keep_rule: Keep only if mean dev spellF1 rises by more than 0.016 (0.04 / sqrt 6) over the current 0.5525 AND improves at least 5 of the 6 folds; otherwise undo. Logged either way.
change_cost._result: Round 1 UNDONE 12 Nov: best (weight 4, cost_h 16) 0.5612 vs control 0.5525, +0.009 < 0.016.

transition_weighting._note: Phase 6 round 2, fixed 12 Nov BEFORE any result. H/A model retrained with the same features and settings, but training rows within +-window_frames of a true H<->A change get weight w (others 1). Segmenter: cost_d 64, cost_h re-checked in grid_cost_h. Same keep rule as round 1 (vs 0.5525).
transition_weighting._result: Round 2 UNDONE 12 Nov: best (weight 10, cost_h 16) 0.5646 vs control 0.5525, +0.012 < 0.016.
